rationale: LPLA is down ~7.4% on a gap open following earnings, currently sitting at 1.6% above today's low with price action showing a failed bounce attempt (last two candles rolling over from ~282 back to ~279.78) and no clear directional conviction. The stock is well below VWAP ($286.18) and the 9-EMA ($285.18), suggesting continued selling pressure, but the proximity to the session low ($279.49) creates two-sided risk — a short risks a low-of-day bounce while a long risks continuation of the gap-fill selling.
